OUR LOCATIONS
Through smart trucking and efficient feed delivery, Commodity Blenders is able to provide you with the best prices and highest quality service no matter your location. Don’t see your state? Contact us to find out if we can deliver to you.

West Salem, Ohio
HQ & Manufacturing Facility
For over two decades, our Ohio manufacturing facility has supplied feed to meet the nutritional needs of livestock and poultry producers. We are proud of enhancing our local community with industry, jobs, and state-of-the-art technology.
Serving Producers across the Midwest
From our Ohio location, we primarily deliver feed to farms in Ohio, Pennsylvania, New York, North Carolina, Virginia, and Tennessee.

Jonesville, Michigan
Manufacturing Facility
Since 2019, our Michigan facility has supplied livestock and poultry producers in the Michigan and northern Indiana markets.
Growing with You
From our Jonesville location, we have the flexibility and opportunity to build our capacity to match what farmers demand in terms of quantity and quality feed.
3611 W. Chicago Rd
Jonesville, MI 49250
(517) 797-4553
Office Hours: M-F 8am-5pm

All other days/hours by Appointment
Warren, Indiana
Manufacturing Facility
Since 2022, our Indiana facility has supplied livestock and poultry producers in the Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin, and Kentucky markets.
Conventional and Organic Certified
Using the state-of-the-art NexGen automation system, our Warren manufacturing facility has the capacity to produce over 60 tons of feed per hour, from custom ingredient blends to finished feed products with precision and consistent quality.
Grain Storage
With capacity to store more than 730 thousand bushels of corn, this facility also houses multiple truck scales, receiving pits, and loadout bays.
10643 S. Hartford City Rd
Warren, IN 46792
(260) 375-3202
Office Hours: M-F 8am-5pm
Shipping/Receiving Hours: M-F 5am-5pm
All other days/hours by Appointment
Indiana Railroad Site
& Office
In addition to our manufacturing facility, our Warren location has a nearby railroad site and office.
Commodity Blenders has a transloading location at its Indiana production campus. We are located on the New Era Railroad and can transload virtually any commodity in a safe and efficient manner. Commodity Blenders has the capability and necessary equipment for railcar-to-truck (hopper or pneumatic) transloading.
